title: Data-Driven Stochastic Optimal Control in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2407.16407v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a fully data-driven approach for optimal control of nonlinear control-affine systems represented by a stochastic diffusion. The focus is on the scenario where both the nonlinear dynamics and stage cost functions are unknown, while only a control penalty function and constraints are provided. To this end, we embed state probability densities into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to leverage recent advances in operator regression, thereby identifying Markov transition operators associated with controlled diffusion processes. This operator learning approach integrates naturally with convex operator-theoretic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman recursions that scale linearly with state dimensionality, effectively solving a wide range of nonlinear optimal control problems. Numerical results demonstrate its ability to address diverse nonlinear control tasks, including the depth regulation of an autonomous underwater

translated_title: 再生核希尔伯特空间中的数据驱动随机最优控制
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种完全数据驱动的方法，用于由随机扩散所描述的非线性仿射控制系统的最优控制。研究聚焦于非线性动力学和阶段成本函数均未知、仅提供控制惩罚函数和约束条件的场景。为此，我们将状态概率密度嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中，以利用算子回归领域的最新进展，从而识别与受控扩散过程相关联的马尔可夫转移算子。这种算子学习方法与随状态维度线性扩展的凸算子理论哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）递归自然融合，能够有效求解广泛的非线性最优控制问题。数值结果证明了该方法处理多种非线性控制任务的能力，包括自主水下航行器的深度调节。
tldr: 该论文提出一种完全数据驱动的方法，在动力学和成本函数均未知的情况下，通过在再生核希尔伯特空间中学习马尔可夫转移算子，并与随状态维度线性扩展的凸算子理论HJB递归相结合，实现非线性随机扩散系统的最优控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully data-driven approach for stochastic optimal control of nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics and costs, by learning Markov transition operators in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and integrating them with convex operator-theoretic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman recursions that scale linearly with state dimensionality.
